portInfo.description: Narvik’s public port lists Pier 3 as an ISPS terminal used for cruise (central harbour Pier 1/3 / Norkaia NONVK0001 in the ISPS description). The Cruise Norway destination sheet states cruise berths at Pier 3, 500 m to town centre, and landing largest ship 350 m. The live Pir 3 facility page publishes a 150 m quay length and LAT depth figure — treat the 350 m ship line as a sheet claim that still needs a primary LOA/assignment table before map import. Anchorage is also described on the sheet (inner ~1,000 m / outer ~3,000 m to tender pier). Door GPS remains null.

climate.description: Subarctic climate with cold winters and cool summers

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Cruise Norway sheet: 500 m to town centre; tourist information 600 m from port. Independent walk-minute survey not done — budget ISPS exit time. Max ships/day 1 and max pax/day 4,000 on the sheet.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Winter northern-lights / summer Skjomen excursions — line products only; not independently timed.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Reconcile your line’s Pier 3 assignment with the published 150 m quay length vs 350 m sheet LOA before assuming alongside.
